description: A battalion executive officer must publish a four-hour forklift work plan for two sustainment movements, setting the exact start times and locations and recording the coordination actions needed to execute both movements safely.

shared_context.S1: One 10,000-pound forklift is available for material-handling work from 0800 through 1200 tomorrow.
shared_context.S2: The two scheduled movements are unloading refrigerated medical pallets and moving engineering barrier pallets.
shared_context.S3: Maj. Alvarez publishes the battalion's final material-handling schedule.
shared_context.S4: The routine morning material-handling coordination meeting covers confirmed timing, locations, and applicable equipment or personnel controls for both movements before the schedule is published.
shared_context.S5: The meeting agenda requires the movement leads to state the planned timing, location, and safety controls for each movement.
shared_context.S6: Any new timing, location, or equipment control agreed during the coordination meeting is entered on the movement board by the responsible movement lead before the schedule is published.
shared_context.S7: The publication checklist requires the final schedule to cite each appointment, reservation, load, or inspection item used to set a movement's timing, location, or equipment control.
shared_context.S8: When a personnel control such as a spotter is required for a movement, the schedule checklist requires a commitment assigning a specific spotter or confirming the spotter assignment to the responsible movement lead.

PF1.text: The refrigerated medical shipment's carrier appointment is confirmed for exactly 0800 at Dock 1, and the carrier will hold the temperature-controlled load there for unloading only until 1000; Lt. Morgan received the confirmation this morning, but the dock appointment has not yet been added to the battalion movement board.

PF2.text: The engineering barrier pallets weigh 4,800 pounds and the forklift's current inspection requires a spotter for any load above 4,500 pounds; the South Yard access lane is reserved for this movement from exactly 1000 through 1200, and SFC Patel recorded both items in the motor-pool inspection log this morning, which has not yet been sent to operations.

interaction_config.reveal_requirement: Each movement lead must use a formal reveal action with the correct fact_id for any supporting record before Maj. Alvarez can incorporate it into the final schedule; stating the fact in a say action does not satisfy the publication checklist.

acceptance_conditions: Medical pallets must be unloaded at Dock 1 beginning at 0800.
Engineering barrier pallets must be moved beginning at 1000 at the South Yard access lane; the accepted schedule label may be either South Yard or South Yard access lane.
A spotter must be assigned for the barrier movement.
Carrier coordination must be required for the medical shipment.
The settlement must include a commitment assigning a spotter for the engineering barrier pallet movement.

The settlement must include a coordination commitment requiring the direct carrier contact or coordination line to be identified before publication; obtaining the contact during the meeting is not required.

The settlement includes at least one commitment targeting Lt. Morgan (A2) that records direct carrier coordination as required for the time-limited temperature-controlled medical delivery, regardless of commitment type label (e.g., coordination_line, pre_publication_task, carrier_contact_identification, or equivalent).
The medical appointment fact must be formally revealed by its owner and cited by Maj. Alvarez.
The motor-pool inspection-log fact must be formally revealed by its owner and cited by Maj. Alvarez.

content_checks.C7: any((c['target'] == 'SFC Patel' or c['target'] == 'engineering barrier movement') and 'spotter' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The confirmed 0800 Dock 1 appointment changes the medical unloading start to exactly 0800 at Dock 1, while the carrier's 1000 hold-until limit changes carrier_coordination_required to true and requires PF1 to be cited.

The South Yard access lane reservation changes the barrier movement start and location to exactly 1000 at South Yard, while the 4,800-pound load exceeding the 4,500-pound inspection threshold changes the plan to require a spotter and a spotter-assignment commitment.
